narrative.overview: The Agentic SDLC Framework governs software engineering through constitutional invariants (INV-01 through INV-04), concentric Clean Architecture rings, causal Architecture Decision Records (ADR-00X), and cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle gate receipts. Its visual identity rejects the generic dark-slate developer dashboard of glowing neon cards and raw <pre> JSON/Markdown dumps in favor of an authoritative Double-Entry Mercantile & Central Bank Audit Ledger. Every commit, ring boundary delta, and ADR adjudication is presented as a balanced, verifiable entry on cool security bond paper with elevated folio sheets and recessed audit wells.
keyCharacteristics: Double-Entry Balance Sheet Topology: Side-by-side Debit and Credit folios pairing Concentric Ring Boundary Deltas against Cryptographic SHA-256 Merkle & Mermaid AST Diffs.
Archival Security Bond Palette: Cool security paper (#eef2f6), elevated folio sheets (#f8fafc), and recessed header wells (#e2e8f0) ruled with hairline (1px) slate dividers.
Cryptographic Seal Semantics: Dedicated verification green, crimson violation, and clearinghouse cobalt ink seals that communicate constitutional status at a glance.

Zero Raw Dumps or Decorative Clutter: All Markdown tables (docs/KANBAN.md, docs/ARCH_TRACE.md) and JSON payloads are parsed into semantic, filterable, sticky-header tables and swimlanes with zero emojis or eyebrow kickers.

rules.name: The Seal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Green, crimson, and cobalt fills appear only on semantic audit seals, active stage pills, and primary interactive controls—never as decorative card backgrounds or side-border stripes.

rules.name: The Cool Security Ground Rule
rules.body: Page and folio grounds maintain a cool slate-tinted bond paper temperature (#eef2f6 / #f8fafc), avoiding warm cream or beige defaults.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Every numeric counter, timestamp, commit hash, SHA-256 digest, and stage index enforces font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional label, badge, or table cell drops below 11px.

rules.name: The Direct Heading Rule
rules.body: Every h1, h2, and h3 stands directly on its own wording without an uppercase kicker or eyebrow label above it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: All internal structure—folio headers, table rows, Kanban swimlanes, and governance desks—is separated by 1px solid rules (#cbd5e1 and #94a3b8), never by heavy drop shadows or thick colored side borders.

dos: Do parse all Markdown (docs/KANBAN.md, docs/ARCH_TRACE.md, PRODUCT.md) and JSON (docs/AUDIT_CHAIN.jsonl) into semantic HTML tables or swimlane cards before rendering.
Do use container-type: inline-size on .table-wrapper and content-visibility: auto on .board-column swimlanes to keep layout and rendering work isolated.
Do keep all functional text at or above 11px and apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to all hashes, counts, and timestamps.
donts: Don't render raw JSON (JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)) or raw Markdown inside <pre> blocks in the operator UI.
Don't use emojis or Unicode icon substitutes anywhere in headings, badges, table cells, or status messages; use crisp 1.75px-stroke inline SVG icons or typographic seal badges.
Don't place uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above h1, h2, or h3 headings, or apply thick colored border-left stripes (> 1px) to cards or callouts.
